# chronosphere_cloudflare_external_connection (Resource)

Cloudflare API token that a `chronosphere_cloud_integration` with `provider_type = "cloudflare"` references through `external_connection_slug` to collect Cloudflare metrics.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "cloudflare_api_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "chronosphere_cloudflare_external_connection" "cloudflare" {
  name      = "Cloudflare"
  api_token = var.cloudflare_api_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) Cloudflare API token used to read analytics. The API never returns the token, so a token changed outside Terraform is not detected, and an imported connection plans one update to set it.
- `name` (String) Display name of the external connection.

### Optional

- `slug` (String) Stable identifier for the connection. Generated from `name` if omitted. Immutable after creation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
